# Gumroad listing — paste-ready

**Product name:** 24 Animated Gym Exercise 3D Models (GLB) — OpenGym3D Pack

**Price:** $19 (suggest launch at $12 for first week; comparable Unity/Sketchfab
exercise-animation packs sit $15–$49)

**URL slug:** opengym3d-exercise-pack

**Cover image:** use `pack/thumbs/squat.png` + a 3×3 grid collage of thumbs
(any collage works; thumbnails are uniform 3D renders on dark background)

**Summary (short):**
24 rigged, animated gym exercises as drop-in .glb files — squat, deadlift,
push-up, plank and 20 more. Works in Three.js, Unity, Godot, Unreal, or a
plain `<model-viewer>` tag. Includes muscle-group manifest + form-cue steps
for every exercise. MIT licensed — ship it in your commercial app.

**Description (long):**

Building a fitness app, workout game, or exercise site? Skip weeks of 3D
work. This pack gives you 24 looping exercise animations, one .glb per
exercise, with a matching PNG thumbnail and a JSON manifest carrying the
name, equipment, difficulty, primary/secondary muscle groups, and
step-by-step form cues for each movement — ready to power cards, tooltips,
and coaching UI, not just visuals.

See every animation live before you buy: https://assiamahs.github.io/opengym3d/

Exercises: Bent-Over Row, Bicep Curl, Calf Raise, Crunch, Deadlift, Dumbbell
Shoulder Press, Front Raise, Glute Bridge, Good Morning, Hammer Curl, High
Knees, Jumping Jack, Lateral Raise, Lunge, Overhead Press, Overhead Tricep
Extension, Plank, Push-Up, Reverse Lunge, Romanian Deadlift, Squat, Sumo
Squat, Superman, Wall Sit.

- glTF binary (.glb), one looping clip baked into each file
- Loads in Three.js / R3F, Babylon, Unity (glTFast), Godot 4, Unreal,
  `<model-viewer>`
- 24 pose-definition JSONs included if you want to retarget or edit timing
- MIT license: commercial use allowed, no attribution required
- ~2.7 MB per model, 43 MB total

**File to upload:** `~/opengym3d/dist/opengym3d-exercise-pack-v1.zip`
